description: Tactile Switch SPST 160gf 2mm SMD (SMT) Tab 4mm x 3mm Surface Mount

provenance.pins: EasyEDA Pro symbol TS-1088-AR02016 and footprint SW-SMD_L3.9-W3.0-P4.45, read with tools/eda.py. The switch has four legs in two internally-common pairs, and this record used to list four pads for that reason - but the library part has TWO, pins 1 and 2, each a 1.23 x 1.86 mm pad spanning both legs of one side. A netlist keying pins 3 and 4 would place nothing.

designVerdict: SELECTED as SW1 (BOOT, GPIO9 to GND) and SW2 (EN to GND). 3.9 x 3 mm SMD tactile.
notes: Recovery hardware. Programming is over the ESP32-C6 native USB-Serial-JTAG on the same USB-C connector that carries PD, so these two are only needed when the firmware will not come up: SW1 holds GPIO9 low at reset to enter the download ROM, SW2 resets.
SPST with two pads per contact. Either pad of a pair may be wired; both are given a pin entry so a netlist that uses all four does not trip K3.
